method: Pixel-sampled foreground/background contrast from paired installed-Chrome screenshots. Each visible text target is captured normally and again with its text color transparent; the second screenshot retains the actual glass, gradient, and backdrop composite. Changed glyph pixels are paired with the corresponding underlying screenshot pixels; computed foreground alpha/ancestor opacity is composited over each sampled background. Text threshold is 4.5:1. Artwork pixels are not UI text.
